caveats: Data source: the given directory icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s1z held only a small daily sample (1982-01-01..1984-09-26) of the product; the full dataset for cmems_obs-sst_bal_phy-temp_my_l4_P1D-m (SST_BAL_SST_L4_REP, 1982-01-01..2023-12-31, same variable analysed_sst, grid and attributes) was found as the single file s2z/sst_s2.nc in the sibling directory and was used. Baseline years 1992-2002 with day-of-year pools of +/-5 calendar days (windows reach 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05, as prescribed); day 60 (29 Feb) filled from days 59/61 then both climatologies smoothed with a centred, wrap-around 31-day moving mean. Sea cells = 3293 cells with finite SST on every target day (of 3600 in the region; 307 land cells are all-NaN and masked 0). Per-cell MHW: hot if SST >= 90th-percentile threshold (Hazen/type 5, NaN-ignoring), runs >= 5 days, gaps of 1-2 days joined; found over 2010-06-01..2010-08-31 only. One regional event: 2010-06-28..2010-07-23 (26 active days). All quantities computed in float64; threshold/climatology and MHW logic verified against independent pure-Python recomputation (agreement to ~2e-13).
